explore-coil.title: A coil across the spectrum
explore-coil.prompt: Raise the frequency until the 10 µH coil's reactance passes 1000 Ω.
hints: Reactance rises with frequency for a coil. Turn right.

explore-cap.title: A capacitor across the spectrum
explore-cap.prompt: Find a frequency where the 10 nF capacitor's reactance is below 10 Ω.
hints: A capacitor's reactance falls as frequency rises.
explore-cap.success: The capacitor all but disappears at RF, while at audio frequencies it opposes strongly.
